web.compat.title: Compatibility
web.compat.subtitle: Some third-party tools (Gemini CLI, certain IDE detectors) only whitelist a fixed set of terminal names. Spoof TERM_PROGRAM here without losing Unterm's identity for everything else.
web.compat.term_program_hint: Default "Unterm". Click a preset below or type a custom value.
web.compat.new_shell_hint: Saved. Open a new tab — running shells keep their old TERM_PROGRAM.
web.scrollback.title: Scrollback
web.scrollback.subtitle: How many output lines each pane keeps in its history buffer. New lines are appended; once the buffer fills, the oldest line is dropped.
web.scrollback.lines_hint: Bigger means more history at the cost of RAM (~96 bytes per cell × cols × lines).
web.scrollback.restart_hint: Saved. New panes use this immediately; restart Unterm to apply to existing panes.
web.reference.title: API & shortcut reference
web.reference.subtitle: Live inventory of every MCP method, CLI subcommand, and currently-bound keyboard shortcut. Same JSON an agent receives from meta.surface.
web.reference.filter_placeholder: Filter by name, summary, or action…
web.reference.keys.hint: Read live from your effective unterm.lua. Asterisk (*) on a param name means required.
web.agents.title: AI Agents
web.agents.subtitle: Install, configure, and launch coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Aider …). Each agent runs inside the identity profile you choose; secrets live in the OS keychain.
web.agents.empty: No AI agents in the current manifest envelope.
web.agents.authmode.title: Authentication mode
web.agents.authmode.subtitle: How calls from this agent are billed. The recommended option uses your vendor subscription (no API key, no per-token charges). Choosing a non-recommended mode is opt-in — Unterm never injects an API key unless this picker is set to one of the byo/endpoint modes.
web.agents.launchflags.title: Launch options
web.agents.launchflags.hint: Optional flags appended to this agent's launch command, saved per profile. Flags marked ⚠ auto-approve actions and bypass Unterm's audit — use with care.
web.agents.secret.set: (stored in OS keychain — paste to replace)
web.agents.confirm.uninstall: Uninstall this agent? Settings stay; rerun install to bring it back.
web.agents.toast.launch_copied: Launch command copied — paste it in a terminal to start the agent.
web.agents.toast.auth_copied: Auth command copied — run it in a real terminal so the vendor's OAuth flow can open your browser.
web.mcp.title: MCP trust & audit
web.mcp.subtitle: Manage which AI agents can write to your terminal without a confirmation banner, and review the audit log of recent MCP-driven PTY writes.
web.mcp.trust.title: Trusted agents
web.mcp.trust.help: Agents listed here skip the first-time-per-agent confirmation banner. Anyone you've ever pressed Alt+A on a banner for is here. Removal is immediate — the next write from that agent will pop the banner again.
web.mcp.trust.runtime_empty: No persisted trust yet. Press Alt+A on a confirmation banner, or add a name below, to grow this list.
web.mcp.trust.static_note: These are pinned in your Lua config. To remove, edit ~/.unterm/unterm.lua. They show with an amber dot to distinguish from the runtime list.
web.mcp.audit.title: Recent activity
web.mcp.audit.help: Last 80 MCP write attempts, newest first. Each row shows when, who, what method, the truncated payload preview, and whether the policy allowed or blocked the call.
web.mcp.confirm.untrust: Stop trusting {name}? The next write from this agent will pop a confirmation banner again.
web.profiles.title: Identity profiles
web.profiles.subtitle: One window per identity. Tokens live in your OS keychain, not in ~/.unterm/. New windows inherit the default profile's env.
web.profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Run the wizard to import from gh / aws / npm / ssh / docker / gcloud / .netrc, or click + New profile.
web.profiles.ssh_include.title: Enable SSH key routing
web.profiles.ssh_include.body: Per-profile SSH keys only take effect once ~/.ssh/config includes Unterm's fragment. Click Install to append the line below; it leaves your existing config untouched.
web.profiles.git.name: Author name
web.profiles.confirm.delete: Delete profile "{name}"? This removes the TOML and clears all of its keychain entries.
web.profiles.confirm.secret_delete: Remove secret {env}? The keychain entry will be deleted.
web.profiles.wizard.title: Onboarding wizard
web.profiles.wizard.subtitle: Found these credentials on your machine. Check the ones you want to bring into a profile and paste the value next to each — Unterm never reads the original tokens, it just suggests where to look.
web.profiles.wizard.empty: Nothing found in any of the 7 supported sources (gh / aws / npm / ssh / docker / gcloud / .netrc). Click + New profile to start from scratch.
web.profiles.toast.secret_required: Both env name and value are required.
web.profiles.toast.ssh_required: Both host and key path are required.
web.profiles.toast.ssh_include_already: Include line was already present in ~/.ssh/config.
web.profiles.wizard.toast.nothing_select: Nothing selected. Check at least one candidate before continuing.
web.profiles.wizard.toast.missing_value: {count} selected candidate(s) need a pasted value before this can finish.
web.general.title: General
web.general.subtitle: Server-side identity and ports for this Unterm instance.
web.general.selftest.title: Self-test
web.appearance.title: Appearance
web.appearance.subtitle: Switch the running terminal's color scheme. Applies instantly.
web.proxy.title: Proxy
web.proxy.subtitle: Route Unterm's outbound HTTP / SOCKS traffic through a local proxy. Auto-detect mirrors the system proxy settings.
web.proxy.auto.label: Auto-detect from system
web.proxy.auto.hint: Use the OS proxy configuration as a starting point.
web.proxy.rotation.label: Auto-rotation
web.proxy.rotation.hint: When the active node stops responding, fail over to the fastest healthy node in the pool.
web.proxy.rotation.no_nodes: No proxy nodes configured yet — add nodes to proxy.json to build a pool.
web.proxy.rotation.add_hint: Add nodes below to build a rotation pool — no need to edit proxy.json.
web.proxy.clash.none: No Clash / mihomo controller found — start your proxy app, or add endpoints manually below.
web.proxy.clash.pool_hint: Tick the nodes to rotate among. When the active one fails, Unterm switches the group to the fastest live pick.
web.proxy.clash.fallback: No proxy controller detected — add endpoint nodes (name + URL) to rotate among.
web.proxy.clash.manual_hint: Can't auto-detect? Point Unterm at your Clash/mihomo controller directly (Settings → external-controller in your proxy app). On Windows this is usually 127.0.0.1:9097.
web.recording.title: Recording
web.recording.subtitle_pre: Captured terminal sessions are stored under
web.recording.subtitle_post: and rendered to redacted markdown on demand.
web.recording.active.title: Active recording
web.recording.active.hint: Toggle from the in-terminal Settings menu (▼) — the active pane is what gets recorded.
web.recording.past.heading: Past sessions ({n})
web.recording.session.label: Session {id}
web.project.title: Project
web.project.subtitle: The current pane's working directory determines the project slug attached to recorded sessions.
web.project.help: To open a different project, use the in-terminal Settings menu (▼) → "Project Directory…".
web.about.title: About
web.about.line: Cross-platform terminal with built-in MCP and HTTP control planes.
